jobs.finding: CONFIRMED_AT_HOSTED_REPOSITORY_REVIEW_SCOPE: the exact module-level origin object can be reused by a same-process caller through the public PerceptionControlResult constructor, so PR395's sentinel is not an unforgeable producer-lineage proof.

jobs.finding: CONFIRMED_AT_HOSTED_REPOSITORY_REVIEW_SCOPE: an evaluator-produced frozen PerceptionControlResult can be mutated after validation with object.__setattr__, so evaluator origin alone is not a content-integrity seal for authority-relevant fields.

baseline_interpretation: Canonical PR395 WP702 tests passed independently in both jobs before each counterexample. The red jobs therefore preserve bounded counterevidence against the stronger producer/content-lineage interpretation rather than showing an unrelated baseline regression.
acceptance_boundary: This receipt does not claim that arbitrary hostile same-process Python code must be made impossible. It establishes that the mechanism in PR395 cannot support an unqualified downstream-consumable producer-lineage/content-integrity claim under the same direct-construction/object-mutation threat model exercised by current project hardening. The canonical owner may either narrow the declared guarantee to cooperative convention fencing or adopt an equivalently stronger consumer/content-bound admission mechanism.
next_exact_action: Canonical WP702 G4 owner should reconcile PR402. Either explicitly narrow G4 acceptance to cooperative accidental-constructor prevention, or bind downstream acceptance to exact current evaluator-produced content with a mechanism that survives the two hosted counterexamples, then rerun canonical tests plus the preserved review falsifiers.
